lessons.title: Taiwan plans to build rare earths plant
lessons.title_zh: 台灣計畫建造稀土工廠

paragraphs.en: Taiwan's Industrial Technology Research Institute (ITRI) plans to construct a rare-earth demonstration plant. The institute hopes this facility can satisfy half of the island's demand by the end of 2030. Concerns over industrial supply chains have grown because China has placed tighter export controls on these critical resources. In a recent interview, ITRI president Chang Pei-zen stated that the facility aims to produce 500 tonnes of rare earths every year.
paragraphs.zh: 台灣工業技術研究院（ITRI）計畫建造一座稀土示範工廠。工研院希望該設施在2030年底前能滿足全台一半的需求。由於中國對這些關鍵資源實施更嚴格的出口管制，各界對產業供應鏈的擔憂與日俱增。工研院院長張培仁在最近的一次專訪中表示，該設施的目標是每年生產500公噸稀土。

paragraphs.en: Construction of the facility is scheduled to finish by the end of 2028. After that, researchers will work to improve the production methods and reach their planned capacity. ITRI intends to place the plant inside an industrial park so that it can eventually be handed over to a private enterprise. The funding would come from the National Science and Technology Council, while financial arrangements such as possible government price guarantees for investors are still being discussed.
paragraphs.zh: 該設施的建設預計於2028年底完工。此後，研究人員將努力改善生產製程並達到預定產能。工研院打算將該工廠設在工業園區內，以便最終能移交給民營企業。資金需由國家科學及技術委員會編列預算，而相關商業安排（包括政府可能為投資者提供價格保證）仍在討論中。

paragraphs.en: Although Taiwan needs a relatively small quantity of rare earths, these elements are essential for high-tech manufacturing. The Ministry of Economic Affairs wants to establish a domestic supply chain to handle export limitations. China's restrictions have highlighted dangers that affect not only raw materials, but also specialized components inside factory machinery. For instance, Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co (TSMC) is searching for alternatives to rare earth parts to prevent disruptions at its advanced semiconductor plants.
paragraphs.zh: 儘管台灣對稀土的需求量相對較小，但這些元素對高科技製造業而言不可或缺。經濟部希望建立國內供應鏈，以因應出口限制。中國的管制凸顯出不僅影響原物料、還波及工廠機械內部專用零組件的風險。例如，台積電（TSMC）正在為稀土零組件尋找替代方案，以防止其先進半導體工廠的運作中斷。

paragraphs.en: Currently, ITRI operates an experimental production line with an annual capacity of only about 5 tonnes. The planned facility would increase this output by 100 times. However, separating rare earth elements is technically difficult because they share similar chemical characteristics. The separation process can require hundreds or thousands of steps, so perfecting it requires significant experience. The institute will also hold more talks to ensure private investors have enough confidence to join the project.
paragraphs.zh: 目前，工研院營運一條年產量僅約5公噸的實驗性生產線。規劃中的新設施將使產量提高100倍。然而，稀土元素的分離在技術上十分困難，因為它們具有相似的化學特性。分離過程可能需要數百甚至數千個步驟，因此完善這項技術需要相當豐富的經驗。工研院也將展開進一步討論，以確保民營投資者有足夠信心參與該專案。

grammar.point: 不定詞表示目的 (Infinitive of Purpose)
grammar.explain: 句中的「to produce」是不定詞結構，用來表達設施設立的目的或目標。
grammar.example: In a recent interview, ITRI president Chang Pei-zen stated that the facility aims to produce 500 tonnes of rare earths every year.
grammar.focus: to produce

grammar.point: 關係代名詞引導的形容詞子句 (Relative Clause with Relative Pronoun)
grammar.explain: 由關係代名詞「that」引導子句修飾前面的先行詞「dangers」，說明這些危險所帶來的具體影響。
grammar.example: China's restrictions have highlighted dangers that affect not only raw materials, but also specialized components inside factory machinery.
grammar.focus: that affect not only raw materials, but also specialized components inside factory machinery

grammar.point: 連接詞 because 引導的原因副詞子句 (Adverb Clause of Reason with 'because')
grammar.explain: 從屬連接詞「because」引導原因副詞子句，說明稀土元素難以分離的原因。
grammar.example: However, separating rare earth elements is technically difficult because they share similar chemical characteristics.
grammar.focus: because they share similar chemical characteristics

lessons.title: Life expectancy in Taiwan increases to 81.27 years
lessons.title_zh: 台灣平均壽命增至81.27歲

paragraphs.en: Average life expectancy in Taiwan climbed to 81.27 years last year, rising from 80.77 years recorded in the previous year, according to the Ministry of the Interior. Even though citizens are living longer, malignant tumors remained the top cause of mortality for the 44th year in a row. Official figures revealed that different forms of cancer caused 54,838 deaths, which represented 27.48 percent of the nation's total fatalities.
paragraphs.zh: 根據內政部資料，台灣去年的平均壽命上升至81.27歲，高於前一年記錄的80.77歲。儘管國人越來越長壽，惡性腫瘤仍連續第44年位居死因榜首。官方資料顯示，各類癌症共奪走5萬4,838條人命，占全國總死亡人數的27.48%。

paragraphs.en: The ministry pointed out that if deaths resulting from cancer had been removed from the statistics, the average lifespan would have increased by 3.7 years to reach 84.97 years. Government researchers evaluated how specific conditions influenced longevity by calculating life expectancy without each major health threat. When the resulting gap between the numbers is wider, that illness exerts a stronger effect on people's general lifespan.
paragraphs.zh: 內政部指出，如果從統計中排除癌症死亡人數，平均壽命本可增加3.7歲，達到84.97歲。政府研究人員藉由計算排除各項重大健康威脅後的平均壽命，來評估特定疾病對壽命的影響。兩者之間的差距越大，代表該疾病對國人整體壽命的影響就越強。

paragraphs.en: According to figures from the Ministry of Health and Welfare, the top ten health conditions ending lives included cancer, heart problems, pneumonia, cerebrovascular illness, diabetes, and high blood pressure. Fatal accidents, kidney disorders, chronic respiratory conditions, and self-harm also appeared on this list. Removing heart disease and pneumonia from the calculations would have extended average lives by 1.54 years and 1.13 years, respectively.
paragraphs.zh: 根據衛生福利部的資料，前十大奪命健康問題包括癌症、心臟疾病、肺炎、腦血管疾病、糖尿病以及高血壓。致命事故、腎病、慢性呼吸道疾病和自殺也名列榜上。若排除心臟疾病和肺炎，平均壽命本可分別延長1.54歲與1.13歲。

paragraphs.en: Encouragingly, the difference between the standard lifespan and the figure without cancer narrowed from 4.1 years in 2015 to 3.7 years recently. Officials indicated that this change demonstrates that the harmful influence of cancer on life expectancy has softened slightly over time.
paragraphs.zh: 令人鼓舞的是，整體平均壽命與排除癌症後的數據差距，已從2015年的4.1歲縮小至近期的3.7歲。官員指出，這項轉變顯示癌症對平均壽命的不利影響隨著時間已略為趨緩。

paragraphs.en: The report also highlighted distinct patterns between genders. Male citizens lost more years of life than female citizens across most major causes of death, although women experienced greater losses from diabetes, high blood pressure, and kidney diseases. For instance, fatal accidents reduced men's lifespan by 0.75 years, while women lost only 0.36 years. Officials suggested that career paths, biological elements, dietary habits, medical care, and daily routines might explain these differences.
paragraphs.zh: 該報告也強調了性別之間的顯著差異。在大多數主要死因中，男性損失的壽命年數皆高於女性，但女性因糖尿病、高血壓及腎臟疾病所損失的壽命則較多。例如，致命事故使男性的壽命減少了0.75歲，而女性僅減少0.36歲。官員表示，職業類別、生理因素、飲食習慣、醫療照護以及生活型態，可能可以解釋這些差異。

grammar.point: 現在分詞片語修飾名詞 (Present Participle Phrase)
grammar.explain: 現在分詞片語 ending lives 作後位修飾語，修飾前面的名詞 health conditions，表示主動結束生命的作用。
grammar.example: According to figures from the Ministry of Health and Welfare, the top ten health conditions ending lives included cancer, heart problems, pneumonia, cerebrovascular illness, diabetes, and high blood pressure.
grammar.focus: ending lives

grammar.point: 關係代名詞非限定用法 (Non-restrictive Relative Clause)
grammar.explain: 在逗號後面使用關係代名詞 which 引導子句，補充說明前面的整件事情（癌症造成54,838人死亡），並在子句中擔任主詞。
grammar.example: Official figures revealed that different forms of cancer caused 54,838 deaths, which represented 27.48 percent of the nation's total fatalities.
grammar.focus: , which represented

lessons.title: Melania Trump brokers localized truce in Ukraine
lessons.title_zh: 梅蘭妮亞・川普促成烏克蘭局部停火

paragraphs.en: US first lady Melania Trump unexpectedly announced that she had arranged a local ceasefire between Russia and Ukraine in the damaged city of Oleshky. Located in the southern Kherson region, the city has been occupied by Russian forces since the 2022 invasion. Many residents there are trapped and facing severe food shortages. Melania Trump stated that her personal intervention was necessary to deliver humanitarian relief and safely evacuate elderly people from the front-line city.
paragraphs.zh: 美國第一夫人梅蘭妮亞・川普（Melania Trump）出人意料地宣布，她已在飽受摧殘的奧萊什基市（Oleshky）促成了俄羅斯與烏克蘭之間的局部停火。該市位於南部赫爾松地區（Kherson），自2022年俄羅斯入侵以來一直被俄軍佔領。那裡的許多居民受困其中，正面臨嚴重的糧食短缺。梅蘭妮亞・川普表示，她的個人介入是必要的，這樣才能將人道救援物資送入這座前線城市，並安全撤離年長者。

paragraphs.en: Military commanders from both Russia and Ukraine confirmed they would observe the truce starting early Tuesday. In addition, civilian leaders from both nations plan to visit Oleshky to evaluate humanitarian needs. Melania Trump, who established a direct communication channel with Russian President Vladimir Putin last October, has been working on separate diplomatic efforts. Through this communication, she has previously helped reunite more than thirty children separated from their parents during the war.
paragraphs.zh: 俄羅斯與烏克蘭雙方的軍事指揮官證實，他們將從週二清晨開始遵守這項休戰協定。此外，兩國的文職官員計畫訪問奧萊什基，以評估人道救援需求。梅蘭妮亞・川普於去年十月與俄羅斯總統普丁（Vladimir Putin）建立了直接溝通管道，並一直致力於平行的外交努力。透過這層溝通，她先前已協助促成了三十多名在戰爭期間與父母失散的兒童團聚。

paragraphs.en: Russian officials officially welcomed the first lady's diplomatic contribution. Meanwhile, US President Donald Trump praised his wife, explaining that she acted on her own initiative because she wanted to save children. When journalists asked whether Melania could participate in future trilateral peace discussions in Abu Dhabi next month, the US president answered, "it’s not the worst idea I’ve ever heard."
paragraphs.zh: 俄羅斯官員正式對第一夫人的外交貢獻表示歡迎。與此同時，美國總統唐納・川普（Donald Trump）讚揚了他的妻子，解釋說這是她自己的倡議，因為她想拯救孩子。當記者詢問梅蘭妮亞下個月是否能參加在阿布達比（Abu Dhabi）舉行的未來三方和平會談時，美國總統回答說：「這並非我聽過最糟的想法。」

paragraphs.en: However, relations between Donald Trump and Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky remain complicated. Zelensky complained that Ukrainian forces continue to encounter speed restrictions on the Starlink and Starshield communication systems, despite Trump's earlier claim that tech leader Elon Musk had restored service. Zelensky also noted that Kyiv is still waiting for American interceptor missiles to defend against Russian attacks. British Prime Minister Andy Burnham likewise emphasized the importance of Starlink access during a recent phone call with Trump.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，唐納・川普與烏克蘭總統弗拉迪米爾・澤倫斯基（Volodymyr Zelensky）之間的關係依然複雜。澤倫斯基抱怨說，儘管川普早些時候聲稱科技巨頭伊隆・馬斯克（Elon Musk）已經恢復了服務，但烏克蘭軍隊在星鏈（Starlink）與星盾（Starshield）通訊系統上仍遭遇速度限制。澤倫斯基還指出，基輔仍在等待美國的攔截飛彈，以防禦俄羅斯的攻擊。英國首相安迪・伯納姆（Andy Burnham）最近在與川普的通話中，同樣強調了烏克蘭完全使用星鏈的重要性。

paragraphs.en: In response to the complaints, Donald Trump promised to contact Elon Musk directly to resolve the communication issues. Over the past two weeks, the American president has shifted his foreign policy closer to Moscow. He delayed sanctions against Russia and announced a diesel agreement to lower global oil prices. In return, the Russian government released an American prisoner and seemingly offered a diplomatic gift to Melania Trump.
paragraphs.zh: 針對這些抱怨，唐納・川普承諾會直接與伊隆・馬斯克聯繫，以解決通訊問題。在過去兩週內，這位美國總統將其外交政策轉向親近莫斯科。他推遲了對俄羅斯的制裁，並宣布了一項柴油協議以壓低全球油價。作為交換，俄羅斯政府釋放了一名美國被拘留者，並似乎給予了梅蘭妮亞・川普一份外交禮物。

grammar.point: 過去完成式 (Past Perfect Tense)
grammar.explain: 句中主要動詞 announced 發生在過去，而子句中「促成停火」發生在宣布之前，因此使用 had + 過去分詞。
grammar.example: US first lady Melania Trump unexpectedly announced that she had arranged a local ceasefire between Russia and Ukraine in the damaged city of Oleshky.
grammar.focus: had arranged

grammar.point: 關係代名詞的非限定用法 (Non-restrictive Relative Clause)
grammar.explain: 由 who 引導的關係子句前後加上逗號，用來對專有名詞先行詞 Melania Trump 進行補充說明。
grammar.example: Melania Trump, who established a direct communication channel with Russian President Vladimir Putin last October, has been working on separate diplomatic efforts.
grammar.focus: who established a direct communication channel with Russian President Vladimir Putin last October

grammar.point: 不定詞表目的 (Infinitive of Purpose)
grammar.explain: 使用 to + 原形動詞表示造訪該市的目的為「評估人道需求」。
grammar.example: In addition, civilian leaders from both nations plan to visit Oleshky to evaluate humanitarian needs.
grammar.focus: to evaluate humanitarian needs

lessons.title: Rosebank: Life on the oil field at the centre of a political storm
lessons.title_zh: 羅斯班克：處於政治風暴中心的油田生活

paragraphs.en: Journalists recently travelled by helicopter to visit Rosebank, a major oil field located northwest of Shetland. The site has become the centre of an intense national debate, coming right after the UK government granted permission for gas extraction at another field named Jackdaw. Rosebank is much larger than Jackdaw, meaning it will produce higher greenhouse gas emissions while offering massive financial returns for its owners.
paragraphs.zh: 新聞記者最近搭乘直升機造訪了位於雪特蘭群島（Shetland）西北方的重大油田「羅斯班克」（Rosebank）。在英國政府剛批准名為「寒鴉」（Jackdaw）的另一處油田進行天然氣開採之後，這個地點便成為全國激烈爭論的焦點。羅斯班克比寒鴉油田規模更大，這意味著它將產生更高的溫室氣體排放量，同時也為其擁有者帶來龐大的財務收益。

paragraphs.en: Work on the field takes place on a massive floating production vessel called the Petrojarl Rosebank. Unlike fixed ocean platforms, this ship rotates around a central point to face severe ocean weather while constantly rolling on Atlantic swells. Over a hundred crew members live and work on board under strict safety rules. Despite the rough environment, workers enjoy private cabins, exercise facilities, and delicious food prepared day and night by talented chefs.
paragraphs.zh: 該油田的作業是在一艘名為「Petrojarl Rosebank」的巨型浮式生產船上進行。與固定式海上平台不同，這艘船會繞著中心點旋轉以迎向嚴酷的海洋氣候，同時在大西洋的湧浪中持續搖晃。超過一百名機組人員在嚴格的安全規定下於船上生活與工作。儘管環境惡劣，工人們仍享有單人艙房、運動設施，以及由優秀廚師日夜烹調的美味餐點。

paragraphs.en: The field contains hundreds of millions of barrels of oil and gas, which could supply energy for about 25 years. As production supervisor Douglas Hogge stated, "We need to see this approved." However, environmental organisations strongly disagree. Campaigners like Tessa Khan from the group Uplift argue that new fossil fuel projects worsen climate change and enrich wealthy corporations. A Scottish court previously declared earlier approvals unlawful because regulators failed to assess emissions from burning the fuel.
paragraphs.zh: 該油田蘊藏數億桶石油與天然氣，可能足以供應約二十五年的能源。正如生產主管 Douglas Hogge 所言：「我們需要看到這個獲得批准。」然而，環保組織對此強烈反對。來自團體 Uplift 的社運人士 Tessa Khan 主張，開發新的化石燃料計畫會加劇氣候變遷，並讓富裕企業賺取暴利。蘇格蘭法院先前曾裁定早期的核准違法，因為監管機構未能評估燃燒這些燃料所產生的排放量。

paragraphs.en: Supporters maintain that the project remains essential for Britain's economy and energy security. Neil McCulloch, chief executive of co-owner Adura, pointed out that gas from Rosebank could heat half a million homes and generate millions in tax revenue. As the UK government prepares to make a final decision before Christmas, the crew on board focuses on daily duties while waiting for news amid incoming winter storms.
paragraphs.zh: 支持者則堅持該計畫對英國的經濟與能源安全依然不可或缺。共同擁有者 Adura 公司的執行長 Neil McCulloch 指出，來自羅斯班克的天然氣可供五十萬戶英國家庭供暖，並產生數百萬的稅款收入。隨著英國政府準備在聖誕節前做出最終決定，船上的工作人員在即將到來的冬季風暴中一邊專注於日常職責，一邊等待消息。

grammar.point: 分詞構句 (Participle Construction)
grammar.explain: 「meaning...」為現在分詞引導的分詞構句，用來修飾前方整件事實，說明其帶來的結果與意涵。
grammar.example: Rosebank is much larger than Jackdaw, meaning it will produce higher greenhouse gas emissions while offering massive financial returns for its owners.
grammar.focus: meaning it will produce higher greenhouse gas emissions while offering massive financial returns for its owners

grammar.point: 不定詞表目的 (Infinitive of Purpose)
grammar.explain: 「to face...」為不定詞結構，在句中用來表達旋轉這個動作的目的，表示「為了面對」。
grammar.example: Unlike fixed ocean platforms, this ship rotates around a central point to face severe ocean weather while constantly rolling on Atlantic swells.
grammar.focus: to face severe ocean weather

grammar.point: 關係代名詞引導的非限定子句 (Non-defining Relative Clause)
grammar.explain: 「which」為關係代名詞，在此代指先行詞「oil and gas」，引導逗號後的非限定子句以補充說明該能源可供應的年限。
grammar.example: The field contains hundreds of millions of barrels of oil and gas, which could supply energy for about 25 years.
grammar.focus: which could supply energy for about 25 years

lessons.title: From Russian cages to Irish sanctuary: The five-year rescue journey of Bu and Tyapa
lessons.title_zh: 從俄羅斯鐵籠到愛爾蘭庇護所：布與提亞帕的五年救援之旅

paragraphs.en: Two brown bears named Bu and Tyapa have begun a peaceful new life at Wild Ireland, an animal sanctuary in County Donegal. Before their rescue, both animals suffered terrible cruelty in the Republic of Dagestan, Russia. Bu was forced to perform in a circus and later locked in a tiny indoor cage. Meanwhile, Tyapa lived in a roofless cage measuring just two and a half meters wide and two meters high, which prevented him from standing upright and left him intended for a taxidermy display.
paragraphs.zh: 兩隻名叫布（Bu）與提亞帕（Tyapa）的棕熊，在多尼戈爾郡（County Donegal）名為「野生愛爾蘭」（Wild Ireland）的動物庇護所展開了平靜的新生活。在獲救之前，這兩隻動物在俄羅斯的達吉斯坦共和國（Republic of Dagestan）遭受了可怕的虐待。布曾被迫在馬戲團表演，後來被關在一個狹小的室內籠子裡。與此同時，提亞帕生活在一個寬僅兩公尺半、高兩公尺的無頂鐵籠中，這使他無法直立站立，並注定要被製成動物標本陳列。

paragraphs.en: When rescuers found the bears, both were severely malnourished, traumatized, and suffering from serious kidney problems caused by dehydration. Wild Ireland founder Killian McLaughlin learned about their plight in 2021 and promised to help them. However, bringing the bears to safety required five years of intense effort. The rescue mission involved more than one hundred professionals, including veterinarians, lawyers, and cargo teams across Russia, the United Arab Emirates, and Ireland.
paragraphs.zh: 當救援人員發現這兩隻熊時，牠們都嚴重營養不良、遭受心靈創傷，並因脫水而患有嚴重的腎臟問題。「野生愛爾蘭」創辦人基利安．麥克勞克林（Killian McLaughlin）於2021年得知了牠們的困境，並承諾要幫助牠們。然而，將這些熊送往安全之地耗費了五年的艱辛努力。這項救援任務動員了一百多位專業人士，包括橫跨俄羅斯、阿拉伯聯合大公國與愛爾蘭的獸醫、律師及貨運團隊。

paragraphs.en: The journey faced numerous obstacles due to international conflicts. The original transport plan through Ukraine became impossible after Russia invaded Ukraine in February 2022. Later, alternative flight routes through the Middle East were disrupted in February 2026 when conflict involving Iran caused airspace closures. In late October 2025, team members Dima and Yana Kim drove thirty-six hours to Dagestan, cut the bears from their rusting cages, and transported them to a sanctuary near St Petersburg for quarantine.
paragraphs.zh: 由於國際衝突，這趟旅程面臨了無數障礙。在俄羅斯於2022年2月入侵烏克蘭後，原定途經烏克蘭的運送計畫變得不可行。後來，經由中東的替代飛行航線在2026年2月受到打亂，當時涉及伊朗的衝突導致空域關閉。在2025年10月下旬，團隊成員迪馬與亞娜．金（Dima and Yana Kim）驅車三十六小時前往達吉斯坦，將兩隻熊從生鏽的鐵籠中切割救出，並運送到聖彼得堡附近的庇護所進行隔離檢疫。

paragraphs.en: The bears finally flew from Moscow to Dublin via Abu Dhabi, arriving in Ireland in August. At Wild Ireland, their health has improved significantly. Their fur is healthier, and recent medical tests show their kidney function is normal again. The staff hide food throughout the woodland habitat to encourage the bears to explore and forage naturally. McLaughlin stated, "We hope they can now have a full and happy life."
paragraphs.zh: 這兩隻熊最終搭機從莫斯科經由阿布達比飛往都柏林，於8月抵達愛爾蘭。在「野生愛爾蘭」，牠們的健康狀況顯著改善。牠們的毛皮變得更健康，近期的醫學檢測也顯示牠們的腎功能已恢復正常。工作人員在林地棲息地各處藏匿食物，以鼓勵棕熊自主探索並覓食。麥克勞克林表示：「我們希望牠們現在能過上充實而快樂的生活。」

grammar.point: 關係代名詞引導的形容詞子句 (Relative Clause with Relative Pronoun)
grammar.explain: 關係代名詞 which 在此引導非限定子句，補充說明前面的鐵籠情況，並在子句中擔任主詞。
grammar.example: Meanwhile, Tyapa lived in a roofless cage measuring just two and a half meters wide and two meters high, which prevented him from standing upright and left him intended for a taxidermy display.
grammar.focus: which prevented him from standing upright and left him intended for a taxidermy display

grammar.point: 過去分詞片語作後置修飾 (Past Participle Phrase as Postmodifier)
grammar.explain: 過去分詞片語 caused by dehydration 作形容詞用，修飾前方名詞 kidney problems，表示被動意味的因果關係。
grammar.example: When rescuers found the bears, both were severely malnourished, traumatized, and suffering from serious kidney problems caused by dehydration.
grammar.focus: caused by dehydration

grammar.point: 不定詞表目的 (Infinitive of Purpose)
grammar.explain: 不定詞片語 to encourage... 表達工作人員在棲息地藏匿食物的「目的」。
grammar.example: The staff hide food throughout the woodland habitat to encourage the bears to explore and forage naturally.
grammar.focus: to encourage the bears to explore and forage naturally

lessons.title: Storm Boelo: Travel disrupted and events cancelled as UK hit by wind and rain
lessons.title_zh: 鮑羅風暴：英國遭受強風暴雨侵襲　交通受阻且活動取消

paragraphs.en: Shortly after Storm Austen hit the United Kingdom on Friday, a second named storm of the season, Storm Boelo, brought severe winds and torrential rain across the country over the weekend. The UK's weather agency, the Met Office, issued amber weather warnings starting Saturday night for Scotland, parts of Northern Ireland, and the far north of England. Coastal areas faced wind gusts reaching up to 80 miles per hour, creating dangerous waves and flying debris that posed a threat to life.
paragraphs.zh: 在奧斯汀風暴（Storm Austen）於週五襲擊英國後不久，本季第二個命名的風暴鮑羅風暴（Storm Boelo）便在週末為全英國帶來了強風與傾盆大雨。英國氣象局（Met Office）發布了自週六晚間開始生效的琥珀色天氣預警，範圍涵蓋蘇格蘭、北愛爾蘭部分地區以及英格蘭極北部。沿海地區面臨高達每小時 80 英里的強陣風，產生了危險的巨浪和漫天飛舞的碎片，對生命構成威脅。

paragraphs.en: The fierce weather followed on the heels of Storm Austen, which had cut power to many homes in south-west England. Although the National Grid restored electricity to more than 131,000 properties by Saturday evening, hundreds of households still remained without electricity. Meanwhile, heavy downpours dumped substantial amounts of rain in areas such as Wiltshire and North Wales, prompting the Environment Agency to issue dozens of flood alerts and warnings across England.
paragraphs.zh: 這場猛烈的天氣緊接在奧斯汀風暴之後發生，該風暴曾導致英格蘭西南部的許多家庭斷電。雖然英國國家電網（National Grid）在週六晚間前已為超過 131,000 戶房產恢復了供電，但仍有數百個家庭沒有電力可用。與此同時，暴雨在威爾特郡（Wiltshire）和北威爾斯等地區傾瀉了大量雨水，促使環境局（Environment Agency）在英格蘭各地發布了數十起洪水警報與警戒。

paragraphs.en: Transportation networks quickly experienced significant chaos. At Dublin Airport, strong winds forced airlines to cancel nearly twenty flights, while several incoming airplanes had to abort their landings and make second attempts or divert elsewhere. Network Rail also urged residents living near tracks to secure their outdoor items after finding a shed and a trampoline blown onto railway property.
paragraphs.zh: 交通運輸網絡迅速經歷了嚴重的混亂。在都柏林機場（Dublin Airport），強風迫使航空公司取消了近二十架航班，而數架進場的飛機不得不放棄降落並嘗試第二次降落或轉降其他地方。英國國家鐵路公司（Network Rail）在發現一間棚屋和一張彈簧床被吹入鐵路區域後，也呼籲住在鐵軌附近的居民牢固固定戶外物品。

paragraphs.en: Safety concerns led officials to call off numerous major public events. Organizers cancelled the River of Light festival in Liverpool as well as London's annual Diwali on the Square celebrations. Famous tourist attractions, such as Edinburgh Castle, also shut their doors to visitors on Sunday. Jason Kelly, the chief forecaster at the Met Office, advised the public to "prepare for the potential for disruption" and monitor the latest weather forecasts closely.
paragraphs.zh: 基於安全考量，官員取消了多項大型公共活動。主辦方取消了利物浦的「光之河」（River of Light）節日以及倫敦一年一度的特拉法加廣場排燈節（Diwali on the Square）慶祝活動。愛丁堡城堡等著名觀光景點也在週日對遊客關閉大門。英國氣象局首席預報員傑森．凱利（Jason Kelly）建議大眾「為可能發生的混亂做好準備」，並密切關注最新的天氣預報。

phrases.zh: 關閉大門；停止對外開放

grammar.point: 分詞構句 (Participle Construction)
grammar.explain: 句末使用逗號連接現在分詞「creating」引導分詞構句，用來表示主要子句動作所帶來的結果或伴隨狀況。
grammar.example: Coastal areas faced wind gusts reaching up to 80 miles per hour, creating dangerous waves and flying debris that posed a threat to life.
grammar.focus: creating dangerous waves and flying debris that posed a threat to life

grammar.point: 過去完成式 (Past Perfect Tense)
grammar.explain: 以「had + 過去分詞」表示在過去另一個動作（followed）發生前就已經完成的事件。
grammar.example: The fierce weather followed on the heels of Storm Austen, which had cut power to many homes in south-west England.
grammar.focus: had cut

grammar.point: 不定詞作受詞補語 (Infinitive as Object Complement)
grammar.explain: 動詞 force 後接受詞 airlines，並使用「to + 原形動詞」的不定詞結構擔任受詞補語，表示「強迫某人做某事」。
grammar.example: At Dublin Airport, strong winds forced airlines to cancel nearly twenty flights, while several incoming airplanes had to abort their landings and make second attempts or divert elsewhere.
grammar.focus: forced airlines to cancel

lessons.title: Trains cancelled and road warnings as Storm Boelo sweeps into Scotland
lessons.title_zh: 暴風雨波洛席捲蘇格蘭，火車停駛且發布道路警報

paragraphs.en: Storm Boelo has brought heavy rain and strong winds to Scotland, causing widespread disruption to transport. An amber weather warning from the Met Office came into effect on Saturday night, covering the mainland and the Western Isles until Sunday night. Forecasters predicted gusts of up to 80mph, warning that the severe weather could cause flying debris, injuries, and power cuts.
paragraphs.zh: 暴風雨波洛（Storm Boelo）為蘇格蘭帶來強降雨與強風，造成廣泛的交通中斷。英國氣象局（Met Office）發布的琥珀色天氣警報於週六晚間生效，涵蓋本土及西部群島直到週日晚間。氣象預報員預測陣風時速可達八十英里，並警告惡劣天氣可能會導致物體飛散、人員受傷以及停電。

paragraphs.en: Public transportation suffered major impacts across the country. Network Rail closed several lines as a precaution and enforced speed restrictions, while services on the Borders line stopped due to ground subsidence. Ferry operator CalMac cancelled all thirty of its services on the west coast for the weekend. In addition, flooding closed multiple major roads, and the Erskine Bridge was shut down for high-sided vehicles.
paragraphs.zh: 全國的大眾運輸遭受重大衝擊。英國鐵路網公司（Network Rail）預先關閉數條路線並實施速度限制，而邊境線的列車服務則因地面下陷而停駛。渡輪營運商 CalMac 取消了週末在西海岸的全部三十條航線服務。此外，洪水封閉了多條主要道路，厄斯金橋（Erskine Bridge）也對高車身車輛關閉。

paragraphs.en: Police Scotland urged drivers to be cautious and to reconsider unnecessary travel. Andy Barclay, deputy head of road policing, asked motorists to think about whether journeys were "really necessary" during the weekend. Meanwhile, the Royal National Lifeboat Institution (RNLI) advised the public to keep away from cliffs, piers, and beaches because powerful waves could easily wash people into the sea.
paragraphs.zh: 蘇格蘭警方呼籲駕駛人保持謹慎，並重新考慮不必要的出行。道路警察部副主管安迪·巴克萊（Andy Barclay）要求駕駛人思考週末期間的行程是否「確實必要」。同時，英國皇家全國救生艇協會（RNLI）建議大眾遠離懸崖、碼頭和海灘，因為強勁的浪潮很容易將人沖入海中。

paragraphs.en: The severe weather also forced the cancellation of many outdoor events and tourist spots. Paisley cancelled its popular Halloween festival on Saturday, and the Enchanted Forest event in Pitlochry was also called off. Furthermore, Historic Environment Scotland closed numerous castles, including Edinburgh Castle and Stirling Castle, while Edinburgh City Council closed public parks to ensure visitor safety.
paragraphs.zh: 惡劣天氣也迫使許多戶外活動與觀光景點取消。佩斯利（Paisley）取消了週六廣受歡迎的萬聖節節慶活動，位於皮特洛赫里（Pitlochry）的迷人森林（Enchanted Forest）活動也被取消。此外，蘇格蘭歷史環境局關閉了包括愛丁堡城堡和史特靈城堡在內的眾多城堡，愛丁堡市議會也關閉了公園以確保遊客安全。

grammar.point: 現在分詞構句 (Present Participle Clause)
grammar.explain: 逗號後使用現在分詞 warning 形成分詞構句，表伴隨狀態或補充說明主詞預報員所發出的警示。
grammar.example: Forecasters predicted gusts of up to 80mph, warning that the severe weather could cause flying debris, injuries, and power cuts.
grammar.focus: , warning that

grammar.point: 被動語態 (Passive Voice)
grammar.explain: 由 be 動詞 was 加上動詞片語的過去分詞 called off 組成，表示活動「被取消」。
grammar.example: Paisley cancelled its popular Halloween festival on Saturday, and the Enchanted Forest event in Pitlochry was also called off.
grammar.focus: was also called off

grammar.point: 名詞子句作介系詞受詞 (Noun Clause as Prepositional Object)
grammar.explain: 由 whether 引導的名詞子句置於介系詞 about 之後作受詞，表示「是否」之意。
grammar.example: Andy Barclay, deputy head of road policing, asked motorists to think about whether journeys were "really necessary" during the weekend.
grammar.focus: whether journeys were "really necessary" during the weekend

lessons.title: Storm Boelo to bring 80mph gusts and heavy rain to parts of UK
lessons.title_zh: 波埃洛風暴將為英國部分地區帶來時速80英里的強陣風與強降雨

paragraphs.en: The United Kingdom is bracing for its second major storm of the weekend, known as Storm Boelo. This weather system is expected to hit northern regions with frequent downpours and strong wind gusts that could exceed 80 miles per hour. This new storm arrives immediately after Storm Austen caused widespread damage on Friday, leaving thousands of households without electricity across south-west England.
paragraphs.zh: 英國正為週末期間被稱為「波埃洛」的第二場大風暴做好準備。預計該天氣系統將伴隨頻繁的大雨侵襲北部地區，強陣風時速可能超過80英里。這場新風暴緊接在週五「奧斯汀」風暴造成廣泛破壞後抵達，導致英格蘭西南部數千戶家庭陷入停電。

paragraphs.en: The national weather service, the Met Office, has urged residents to stay inside whenever possible because flying debris and rough coastal waves could create danger to human life. Forecasters released an amber alert, which is their second highest weather warning level, for Scotland, parts of northern England, and north-east Northern Ireland. A broader yellow warning for wet and stormy conditions also covers the entire northern half of the country throughout the weekend.
paragraphs.zh: 英國國家氣象局呼籲居民盡可能留在室內，因為四處飛散的碎片與沿海的巨浪可能對人身生命構成威脅。氣象預報員針對蘇格蘭、英格蘭北部部分地區以及北愛爾蘭東北部發布了琥珀色警報，這是該國第二嚴重的天氣警戒級別。涵蓋範圍更廣的濕冷暴風黃色警告也在整個週末期間籠罩該國北半部全境。

paragraphs.en: Severe travel problems are anticipated on rail routes and ferry services. Rail companies have advised passengers to cancel non-essential trips, and one major operator told customers not to travel north of Preston on Sunday. In addition, officials expressed concern that the power outages experienced in the south-west, where over 31,000 homes lost power on Friday, might happen again in the northern alert zones.
paragraphs.zh: 鐵路路線和渡輪服務預計會出現嚴重的交通受阻情況。鐵路公司已建議乘客取消非必要的行程，且一家主要營運商告知顧客週日不要前往普雷斯頓以北地區。此外，官員們表示擔憂，週五英格蘭西南部超過3萬1000戶停電的災情，可能會在北部的警報區域重演。

paragraphs.en: Meteorologists explained that Storm Boelo's wind speeds will reach their peak on Saturday evening. Meanwhile, experts note that human-induced climate change continues to disrupt global weather patterns, following the UK's hottest summer on record with five severe heatwaves. Observing these extreme conditions, Andy Burnham warned that the country could experience "a winter of greater flooding." In response, the prime minister stated that the government remains prepared, although unusual weather events are happening more frequently.
paragraphs.zh: 氣象學家解釋說，波埃洛風暴的風速將在週六晚間達到巔峰。與此同時，專家指出，在英國經歷了有紀錄以來最炎熱的夏季並出現五波嚴重熱浪之後，人為造成的氣候變遷正持續打亂全球的天氣型態。目睹這些極端情況，安迪．伯納姆警告該國可能會面臨「更嚴重洪患的冬季」。對此，英國首相表示政府依然有做好準備，儘管不尋常的天氣事件發生得越來越頻繁。

grammar.point: 分詞構句 (Participle Construction)
grammar.explain: 現在分詞短語「leaving...」作為分詞構句，在主要子句之後補充說明暴風雨所造成的附帶結果。
grammar.example: This new storm arrives immediately after Storm Austen caused widespread damage on Friday, leaving thousands of households without electricity across south-west England.
grammar.focus: leaving thousands of households without electricity across south-west England

grammar.point: 非限定關係子句 (Non-defining Relative Clause)
grammar.explain: 關係代名詞「which」引導非限定關係子句，前後以逗號隔開，用來補充補充說明先行詞「an amber alert」。
grammar.example: Forecasters released an amber alert, which is their second highest weather warning level, for Scotland, parts of northern England, and north-east Northern Ireland.
grammar.focus: which is their second highest weather warning level

grammar.point: 名詞子句作受詞 (Noun Clause as Object)
grammar.explain: 從屬連接詞「that」引導名詞子句，在句中擔任主要子句動詞「explained」的受詞。
grammar.example: Meteorologists explained that Storm Boelo's wind speeds will reach their peak on Saturday evening.
grammar.focus: that Storm Boelo's wind speeds will reach their peak on Saturday evening

lessons.title: Golden State Valkyries beat the Atlanta Dream to even the WNBA Finals at 2-2
lessons.title_zh: 金州女武神擊敗亞特蘭大美夢 將WNBA總決賽扳成2比2平手

paragraphs.en: The Golden State Valkyries defeated the Atlanta Dream 67-62 on Saturday, tying the Women's National Basketball Association (WNBA) Finals at 2-2. Gabby Williams led the team with 17 points as Golden State relied on stellar defense to secure the victory. The best-of-seven championship series will now head back to California on Monday for Game 5.
paragraphs.zh: 金州女武神隊（Golden State Valkyries）週六以67比62擊敗亞特蘭大美夢隊（Atlanta Dream），在美國女子職業籃球聯賽（WNBA）總決賽中將戰局扳成2比2平手。蓋比·威廉斯（Gabby Williams）攻下全隊最高的17分，而金州隊依靠出色的防守鎖定勝局。這個七戰四勝制的冠軍系列賽將在週一回到加州進行第五戰。

paragraphs.en: A major key to the win was slowing down Atlanta star Angel Reese. Reese had dominated the previous two games with an average of 25.5 points and 14 rebounds, but Golden State limited her to just eight points on Saturday. She struggled from the floor, missing 10 of her 12 field goal attempts after recording a double-double in each of the series' first three contests.
paragraphs.zh: 這場勝利的一大關鍵在於壓制亞特蘭大球星安潔兒·里斯（Angel Reese）。里斯在先前的兩場比賽中佔據主導地位，平均每場拿下25.5分和14個籃板，但金州隊在週六將她限制到僅得8分。在系列賽前三場都拿下雙十成績後，她在這場比賽中手感冰冷，12次出手投丟了10球。

paragraphs.en: Golden State coach Natalie Nakase adjusted the starting lineup by inserting Tiffany Hayes and Kaila Charles. Although the Valkyries began slowly, bench contributions from Kayla Thornton and Cecilia Zandalasini sparked a first-quarter rally. Golden State later ended the second quarter with an 18-6 run to take a 42-26 lead at halftime, marking Atlanta's largest deficit of the postseason.
paragraphs.zh: 金州隊總教練納塔莉·中瀨（Natalie Nakase）調整了先發陣容，換上蒂芬妮·海耶斯（Tiffany Hayes）與凱拉·查爾斯（Kaila Charles）。儘管女武神隊開局緩慢，但替補球員凱拉·桑頓（Kayla Thornton）與塞西莉亞·贊達拉西尼（Cecilia Zandalasini）的貢獻激發了第一節的反撲。金州隊隨後在第二節尾聲打出一波18比6的攻勢，在半場結束時取得42比26的領先，這也是美夢隊在整個季後賽中所面臨的最大落後差距。

paragraphs.en: Hayes contributed all 13 of her points during the second half. After the game, she noted, "We just had to have more fight, more grit." Meanwhile, center Kiah Stokes controlled the paint with 16 rebounds and three blocked shots. Stokes set a new WNBA Finals record with 14 total blocks across four games, surpassing the previous mark of 12 shared by Brittney Griner and Sylvia Fowles.
paragraphs.zh: 海耶斯的13分全部是在下半場攻下的。賽後她表示：「我們就必須展現更多鬥志、更多毅力。」與此同時，中鋒基雅·斯托克斯（Kiah Stokes）以16個籃板和3次阻攻鞏固了禁區。斯托克斯在四場比賽中累計達成14次阻攻，創下WNBA總決賽新紀錄，打破了先前由布蘭妮·格里納（Brittney Griner）與席薇亞·佛利斯（Sylvia Fowles）共同保持的12次紀錄。

paragraphs.en: Atlanta made a late push in the fourth quarter in front of a sellout crowd of more than 17,000 fans. Led by Rhyne Howard, who finished with 19 points, the Dream cut the deficit to 66-62 with 28 seconds remaining. However, Veronica Burton sank a crucial free throw, and Atlanta failed to score again, sealing the Valkyries' first win since Game 1.
paragraphs.zh: 亞特蘭大隊在超過17,000名滿場觀眾面前於第四節發動了反撲。在全場攻下19分的萊恩·霍華德（Rhyne Howard）帶領下，美夢隊在比賽僅剩28秒時將差距縮小至66比62。然而，維羅妮卡·伯頓（Veronica Burton）罰進了一記關鍵罰球，而美夢隊在隨後的回合未能得分，確定由女武神隊奪得自第一戰以來的首場勝利。

grammar.point: 分詞構句 (Participle Construction)
grammar.explain: 此處使用逗號接現在分詞「tying」構成伴隨狀況的分詞構句，用來說明主句動作發生後產生的結果。
grammar.example: The Golden State Valkyries defeated the Atlanta Dream 67-62 on Saturday, tying the Women's National Basketball Association (WNBA) Finals at 2-2.

grammar.explain: 以「had + 過去分詞（dominated）」表示在過去特定時間點（週六的第四戰）之前就已經持續或完成的動作。
grammar.example: Reese had dominated the previous two games with an average of 25.5 points and 14 rebounds, but Golden State limited her to just eight points on Saturday.
grammar.focus: had dominated

grammar.point: 非限定關係子句 (Non-defining Relative Clause)
grammar.explain: 關係代名詞「who」引導逗號隔開的非限定關係子句，用來對前方專有名詞「Rhyne Howard」補充額外資訊。

grammar.focus: who finished with 19 points

lessons.title: Knicks try to clear up ‘misinformation’ about rings, say employees will get them in 4-6 weeks
lessons.title_zh: 尼克隊試圖澄清冠軍戒指的「錯誤訊息」，表示員工將在四到六週內拿到戒指

paragraphs.en: The New York Knicks are trying to correct what they described as false rumors about their championship rings. The team stated that staff members who were promised rings will receive them in about one month. Madison Square Garden (MSG) has faced criticism for two days straight regarding how they are handing out the jewelry, following the team's first title victory since 1973.
paragraphs.zh: 紐約尼克隊（New York Knicks）正試圖澄清他們所謂關於冠軍戒指的錯誤傳聞。該隊伍表示，獲承諾享有戒指的職員將在大約一個月內收到它們。麥迪遜廣場花園（MSG）連續兩天因其發放該珠寶的方式而面臨批評，此前該球隊贏得了自1973年以來的首座冠軍。

paragraphs.en: During Tuesday night's season opener against the Philadelphia 76ers, Knicks players received their championship rings. However, a sports media outlet called The Athletic reported that assistant coaches were left without theirs. In response, MSG clarified on Friday that over 275 staff members will indeed be given rings, with the entire collection valued at more than 3.7 million dollars.
paragraphs.zh: 在週二晚上面對費城76人隊（Philadelphia 76ers）的開幕戰期間，尼克隊球員領取了他們的冠軍戒指。然而，一家名為《The Athletic》的體育媒體報導指出，助理教練們並沒有拿到他們的戒指。對此，MSG在週五澄清表示，超過275名職員確實將會獲贈戒指，整批戒指的價值超過370萬美元。

paragraphs.en: An MSG spokesperson explained that teams usually present players with their rings during the opening ceremony, while other workers receive theirs later. According to the spokesperson, everyone else will get their jewelry in roughly four to six weeks. The organization insisted that there is considerable misinformation regarding their distribution plan.
paragraphs.zh: 一位MSG發言人解釋說，各隊伍通常會在開幕儀式上將戒指頒發給球員，而其他員工則會在稍後收到他們的戒指。根據該發言人的說法，其餘所有人將在大約四到六週內拿到他們的珠寶。該機構堅持認為，關於他們的發放計畫存在著大量的錯誤訊息。

paragraphs.en: Meanwhile, the organization admitted another mistake concerning an internal training test. Back in September, employees received a fake email inviting them to choose their ring styles. Unfortunately, workers who clicked the provided link were forced to join a mandatory cybersecurity class. MSG apologized for using the championship rings in this simulated phishing test, but they defended their overall effort to protect the company's intellectual property.
paragraphs.zh: 與此同時，該機構承認了另一項涉及內部培訓測試的錯誤。早在九月時，員工們收到了一封虛假電子郵件，邀請他們挑選自己的戒指款式。不幸的是，點擊所提供連結的員工被迫參加一堂強制性的網路安全課程。MSG為在此次模擬釣魚測試中使用冠軍戒指而道歉，但他們為保護公司智慧財產權的整體努力進行了辯護。

paragraphs.en: An MSG spokesperson noted that the historic victory brought huge excitement to New York. The spokesperson claimed that people who choose to focus on negative details are simply missing out on the joy of this amazing achievement.
paragraphs.zh: MSG發言人指出，這場歷史性的勝利為紐約帶來了巨大的喜悅。該發言人聲稱，選擇聚焦於負面細節的人，只不過是錯失了這項驚人成就所帶來的喜悅。

grammar.point: 受詞子句 (Noun Clause as Object)
grammar.explain: that 引導的名詞子句放在動詞 stated 後面，作為該動詞的受詞。
grammar.example: The team stated that staff members who were promised rings will receive them in about one month.
grammar.focus: that staff members who were promised rings will receive them in about one month

grammar.point: 關係代名詞當主詞 (Subject Relative Pronoun)
grammar.explain: 關係代名詞 who 引導形容詞子句修飾先行詞 workers，並在子句中作主詞。
grammar.example: Unfortunately, workers who clicked the provided link were forced to join a mandatory cybersecurity class.
grammar.focus: who clicked the provided link

grammar.point: 被動語態 (Passive Voice)
grammar.explain: 由 were forced 構成過去式的被動語態，表示員工「被迫」參加課程。
grammar.example: Unfortunately, workers who clicked the provided link were forced to join a mandatory cybersecurity class.
grammar.focus: were forced

lessons.title: New maps reveal who could see more snow during this year’s super El Niño
lessons.title_zh: 新地圖揭示誰可能在今年的超級聖嬰現象期間看到更多降雪

paragraphs.en: A potentially record-setting El Niño is expected to influence winter weather across the United States. El Niño is a natural climate event characterized by unusually warm water in central and eastern parts of the tropical Pacific Ocean. This extra warmth alters global atmospheric circulation and shifts the jet stream south and east across North America, bringing wetter conditions to the southern part of the country and milder temperatures to the north.
paragraphs.zh: 一場可能創下紀錄的聖嬰現象預計將影響全美的冬季天氣。聖嬰現象是一種自然氣候事件，其特徵是熱帶太平洋中部和東部海域出現異常溫暖的海水。這種額外的熱量改變了全球大氣環流，並將噴射氣流向南和向東推進橫跨北美洲，為該國南部帶來更潮濕的環境，並為北部帶來較溫和的氣溫。

paragraphs.en: However, wetter weather does not always guarantee more snow. Snowstorms require sufficiently cold air, so higher precipitation simply means rain if temperatures are too high. To understand historical trends, CNN Weather examined snowfall records from 1959 to 2026. Their findings show how past El Niño winters differed from normal conditions, providing clues for the upcoming season rather than exact predictions.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，更潮濕的天氣並不一定保證會有更多降雪。暴風雪需要足夠寒冷的空氣，因此如果氣溫過高，降水量的增加僅僅代表會有更多降雨。為了了解歷史趨勢，CNN氣象部門檢視了1959年至2026年的降雪紀錄。他們的研究結果顯示過去的聖嬰冬季與正常情況有何不同，為即將到來的季節提供線索，而非精確的預測。

paragraphs.en: Historically, snowfall was often above average across the southern United States, including parts of the Southwest and the Mid-Atlantic. Coastal storms known as nor'easters can become especially powerful. Jon Gottschalck from the Climate Prediction Center of the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration (NOAA) stated that these storms are "very strong, energetic and they're very wet." Consequently, cities like Washington, DC, and Baltimore could experience heavier snowfall than usual. Conversely, northern regions like the Pacific Northwest and Great Lakes typically received less snow.
paragraphs.zh: 歷史上，美國南部的降雪量通常高於平均水準，包括西南部和大西洋中部部分地區。被稱為「東北風暴」的沿海風暴可能會變得特別強大。美國國家海洋暨大氣總署（NOAA）氣候預測中心的強恩·戈特沙爾克（Jon Gottschalck）表示，這些風暴「非常強烈、充滿能量且非常潮濕」。因此，像華盛頓特區和巴爾的摩這樣的城市可能會經歷比平時更多的降雪。相反地，像太平洋西北地區和五大湖區等北部地區通常降雪較少。

paragraphs.en: This year's event is predicted to be one of the strongest on record. While a stronger El Niño makes typical patterns more likely, Gottschalck noted that it does not necessarily produce more moisture at specific locations. In addition, scientists have relatively few historical cases of strong El Niño events to study, which makes firm conclusions difficult to draw.
paragraphs.zh: 今年的事件預計將是有紀錄以來最強烈的事件之一。雖然更強烈的聖嬰現象使典型模式出現的可能性增加，但戈特沙爾克指出，這並不一定會在特定地點帶來更多水氣。此外，科學家可供研究的強烈聖嬰現象歷史案例相對較少，這使得人們很難得出明確的結論。

paragraphs.en: For the coming winter months, NOAA expects warmer-than-average temperatures in much of the northern and eastern United States due to Pacific air. Nevertheless, unexpected shifts in Arctic air could still trigger sudden cold snaps. Even in a generally mild season, a single powerful blizzard can dramatically increase total snowfall, just as a historic 2016 blizzard did in New York City during a previous strong El Niño.
paragraphs.zh: 在即將到來的冬季幾個月中，由於太平洋空氣的影響，NOAA預計美國北部和大西洋東部大部分地區的氣溫將高於平均。儘管如此，北極空氣出乎意料的轉變仍可能引發突如其來的寒潮。即使在一個整體溫和的季節裡，單是一場強大的暴風雪就可能大幅增加總降雪量，就像2016年一場具歷史意義的暴風雪在先前強烈聖嬰現象期間於紐約市所造成的影響一樣。

lessons.title: We have more clothing options than ever. Why is shopping so hard?
lessons.title_zh: 我們擁有的服飾選擇比以往任何時候都多。為什麼買衣服卻變得如此困難？

paragraphs.en: In Brooklyn, New York, designer Naomi Mishkin runs a small clothing brand named Naomi Nomi. Unlike fast-fashion companies that reduce production expenses to the minimum, she crafts shirts locally using natural fabrics such as cotton and wool. Her garments are expensive and never discounted, with a classic cotton shirt costing 268 dollars. Instead of keeping a huge inventory, she makes items only after customers place their orders.
paragraphs.zh: 在紐約布魯克林，設計師 Naomi Mishkin 經營著一家名為 Naomi Nomi 的小型服飾品牌。與將生產成本削減至最低的快時尚公司不同，她在當地使用棉和羊毛等天然布料製作襯衫。她的服裝價格昂貴且從不打折，一件經典的棉質襯衫要價 268 美元。她沒有保留龐大的庫存，而是在顧客下單後才製作商品。

paragraphs.en: Many shoppers are growing tired of modern clothing quality. Even though prices at popular mall brands continue to climb, garments often wear out quickly, pill after a few washes, or contain uncomfortable synthetic materials. According to Neil Saunders, a managing director at GlobalData, consumers are now "more interested in buying less, but buying right." Instead of purchasing multiple cheap items, more buyers, especially younger generations, prefer to invest in durable shirts or shop secondhand.
paragraphs.zh: 許多消費者對現代服裝的品質越來越厭倦。儘管知名購物中心品牌的價格持續攀升，但衣服往往很快就穿壞、洗幾次後就起毛球，或含有令人不適的合成材質。根據 GlobalData 零售業務總監 Neil Saunders 所說，消費者現在「對買少一點，但買好一點更感興趣」。許多買家（尤其是年輕一代）不再購買多件便宜的商品，而是更願意投資耐穿的襯衫或購買二手衣物。

paragraphs.en: This shift in the clothing market has developed over several decades. In 1980, an average American bought only 12 to 14 pieces of clothing each year, but that number climbed to 68 by 2018. Research from McKinsey shows that global garment production doubled between 2000 and 2014. Meanwhile, brands moved manufacturing overseas to seek cheaper labor, and European fashion houses began releasing far more seasonal collections. To maintain low prices and higher corporate profits, apparel makers increasingly turned to synthetic plastics like polyester, which now appear in around 60 percent of new clothes.
paragraphs.zh: 服飾市場的這種轉變已經發展了數十年。在 1980 年，美國人平均每年只購買 12 到 14 件衣服，但到了 2018 年，這個數字攀升至 68 件。麥肯錫（McKinsey）的研究顯示，全球服裝產量在 2000 年至 2014 年間翻了一倍。與此同時，各品牌將製造業務轉移到海外以尋求更廉價的勞動力，而歐洲時裝公司也開始推出多出數倍的季節系列。為了維持低廉的價格和更高的企業獲利，服裝製造商越來越多地採用聚酯纖維等合成塑膠，如今約有百分之六十的新衣服都含有這些材質。

paragraphs.en: Today, the fashion industry manufactures an estimated 100 billion items annually, yet much of it ends up discarded in landfills. Author Dana Thomas explains that clothing only seems cheap because workers along the supply chain are underpaid. As consumers finally notice poor craftsmanship and flimsy materials, small labels that prioritize lasting value are gaining traction. For creators like Mishkin, fair wages for local workers and durable quality remain the true key to survival.
paragraphs.zh: 如今，時尚產業每年生產估計達一千億件服飾與配件，然而其中大部分最終都被丟棄在垃圾掩埋場。作家 Dana Thomas 解釋，衣服看似便宜，只是因為供應鏈上的勞工沒有獲得應得的薪酬。隨著消費者終於注意到粗劣的做工和脆弱的材質，重視持久價值的微型品牌正在獲得關注。對 Mishkin 這樣的創作者來說，為當地工人提供合理薪水和經久耐用的品質，仍然是生存的真正關鍵。

grammar.point: 分詞構句 (Participle Construction)
grammar.explain: 句尾以現在分詞短語「using...」作伴隨狀語，說明主詞在製作襯衫時所使用的方式或工具。
grammar.example: Unlike fast-fashion companies that reduce production expenses to the minimum, she crafts shirts locally using natural fabrics such as cotton and wool.
grammar.focus: using natural fabrics such as cotton and wool

grammar.point: 不定詞表示目的 (Infinitive of Purpose)
grammar.explain: 不定詞片語「to seek...」在此作副詞使用，表示主要子句中品牌將製造業務外移的目的。
grammar.example: Meanwhile, brands moved manufacturing overseas to seek cheaper labor, and European fashion houses began releasing far more seasonal collections.
grammar.focus: to seek cheaper labor

grammar.point: 關係代名詞引導的形容詞子句 (Relative Clause with Relative Pronoun)
grammar.explain: 以關係代名詞「which」引導非限定形容詞子句，對前方先行詞「synthetic plastics like polyester」進行補充說明。
grammar.example: To maintain low prices and higher corporate profits, apparel makers increasingly turned to synthetic plastics like polyester, which now appear in around 60 percent of new clothes.
grammar.focus: which now appear in around 60 percent of new clothes

lessons.title: At one Atlanta restaurant, workers are family. A health insurance crisis tested that commitment
lessons.title_zh: 在亞特蘭大的一家餐廳裡，員工就是家人。一場健康保險危機考驗了這份承諾

paragraphs.en: Jen Chan and her wife, Emily, co-own a popular Chinese and pizza restaurant and a bodega in Atlanta. Last year, doctors diagnosed Jen with an aggressive form of breast cancer. After months of grueling treatment, they thought she had reached the end, but follow-up tests revealed cancer cells in her lymph nodes. As Jen faced another year of chemotherapy, the couple received alarming news from their insurance broker about skyrocketing costs.
paragraphs.zh: 珍·陳（Jen Chan）和她的妻子愛蜜莉（Emily）在亞特蘭大共同經營一家受歡迎的中式披薩餐廳和一家小型雜貨店。去年，醫生診斷出珍罹患了一種侵襲性乳癌。經過數月的艱苦治療，他們以為她已經挺過來了，但後續檢查卻發現她的淋巴結中有癌細胞。正當珍面臨又一年的化療時，這對伴侶收到了保險經紀人關於費用飆升的驚人消息。

paragraphs.en: Industry surveys show that only about a third of United States restaurants offer health insurance because small businesses often face severe financial hurdles. The Chans' independent insurance broker explained that after recent employee claims, their insurance bill would double for everyone. Because their policy is partially self-funded, employers assume the risk of paying claims directly. When an employee suffers a serious illness, costs can soar rapidly.
paragraphs.zh: 產業調查顯示，美國大約只有三分之一的餐廳提供健康保險，因為小型企業經常面臨嚴重的財務障礙。陳姓夫婦的獨立保險經紀人解釋說，在最近的員工理賠之後，他們所有人的保險帳單將會加倍。由於他們的保單是部分自籌資金的，因此雇主需承擔直接支付理賠的風險。當員工罹患重病時，成本可能會迅速飆升。

paragraphs.en: By summer, the Chans faced steep medical bills and unaffordable insurance rates. Dropping coverage was impossible because it would end Jen's lifesaving treatment and their staff's benefits. To solve this problem, Emily started a crowdfunding campaign online. Devoted customers and community members generously donated more than one hundred twenty-eight thousand dollars to help them.
paragraphs.zh: 到了夏天，陳姓夫婦面臨高昂的醫療帳單和難以負擔的保險費率。放棄保險是不可能的，因為這將終止珍的救命治療以及他們員工的福利。為了解決這個問題，愛蜜莉在網路上發起了一場群眾募資活動。忠實的顧客和社區成員慷慨捐贈了超過十二萬八千美元來幫助他們。

paragraphs.en: The strong community support reflected the deep connections the restaurant had built over the years. The Chans created a warm environment with neighborhood-friendly touches and excellent food. Their story highlights the severe financial difficulties that small business owners and hospitality workers face when dealing with serious health crises in the American healthcare system.
paragraphs.zh: 強大的社區支持反映了這家餐廳多年來建立的深厚聯繫。陳姓夫婦透過充滿鄰里情誼的細節和美味的食物，營造出溫馨的環境。他們的故事突顯了當小型企業主和餐飲業員工在美國醫療體系中面臨嚴重的健康危機時，所遭遇的沉重財務困境。

lessons.title: AI found the flaw. Hackers found the leak: The race to save 'PHP2SHELL'
lessons.title_zh: AI 發現漏洞，駭客發現外洩：搶救「PHP2SHELL」的競賽

paragraphs.en: Internet security researchers recently made a startling discovery by using artificial intelligence. They found serious security flaws in PHP, a decades-old software program that powers about seventy percent of websites across the internet. This critical vulnerability, known as PHP2SHELL, could allow attackers to take control of web servers without entering any passwords or leaving behind any digital fingerprints.
paragraphs.zh: 網路安全研究人員最近利用人工智慧有了一項令人震驚的發現。他們在 PHP 中發現了嚴重的安全漏洞，這是一套已有數十年歷史、為網路上約百分之七十網站提供支援的軟體程式。這個名為 PHP2SHELL 的重大漏洞，能讓攻擊者在無需輸入任何密碼且不留下任何數位指紋的情況下，接管網站伺服器。

paragraphs.en: Kevin Roose, a co-host of the NPR podcast called Machine Gods, explained that researchers initially tried to keep the flaw secret while racing to repair it. However, the information leaked out, and hackers quickly swooped in. Because modern AI tools can also help offenders write malicious code, defenders are now trapped in a tense cat-and-mouse game to patch systems before attackers can break inside.
paragraphs.zh: 全國公共廣播電台（NPR）名為《機器之神》（Machine Gods）的播客共同主持人凱文．羅斯（Kevin Roose）解釋說，研究人員最初試圖對該漏洞保密，同時爭分奪秒地進行修復。然而，消息卻外洩了，駭客迅速蜂擁而入。因為現代 AI 工具也能協助犯罪者快速撰寫惡意程式碼，防禦人員如今陷入了一場緊張的貓捉老鼠遊戲，必須在攻擊者闖入之前為系統安裝修補程式。

paragraphs.en: Furthermore, this dangerous situation goes far beyond PHP alone. Security experts report that AI systems have become exceptionally skilled at finding bugs in core software that people have used for decades, including banking networks, Node.js, and Plex. Because AI tools can persistently test digital locks until they succeed, a record number of flaws has appeared. Due to these sudden threats, some researchers are calling this period "Black October."
paragraphs.zh: 此外，這種危險情況遠遠不只限於 PHP。安全專家指出，AI 系統已極度擅長在人們使用了數十年的核心軟體中找出錯誤，包括銀行系統、Node.js 以及 Plex。由於 AI 工具能夠堅持不懈地測試數位鎖直到成功為止，近期出現的漏洞數量創下了歷史新高。由於這些突如其來的威脅，一些研究人員將這段時期稱為「黑色十月」（Black October）。

paragraphs.en: Security specialists expect that nearly every week for the next year or two will feel like a fresh crisis as AI crawls the internet. Nevertheless, Roose noted that systems could become much more secure in the long run once these vulnerabilities are eliminated. Until then, individuals should take sensible precautions, such as updating their software, rotating old passwords, and using reliable password managers.
paragraphs.zh: 安全專家預估，隨著 AI 在網路上全面搜尋，在未來一兩年內，幾乎每個星期都會感覺像是一場新的危機。儘管如此，羅斯指出，一旦這些漏洞被修復，長遠來看系統可能會變得安全得多。在那之前，個人應該採取明智的預防措施，例如更新軟體、定期更換舊密碼，以及使用可靠的密碼管理工具。

lessons.title: Time expert Philippe Richard on why scientists are changing how we keep time
lessons.title_zh: 時間專家菲利普・理查談科學家為何要改變我們的計時方式

paragraphs.en: Most people believe that one full rotation of the Earth takes exactly 24 hours. In reality, the Earth's spin has slowed down slightly, making each day last 24 hours plus a few microseconds. To make up for this tiny difference, scientists have added leap seconds every few years since 1972. However, this long-standing practice is now about to change.
paragraphs.zh: 大多數人認為地球自轉一圈恰好需要二十四小時。事實上，地球的自轉略微變慢，使得每一天持續二十四小時再加上幾微秒。為了彌補這微小的差距，科學家自 1972 年起每隔幾年就會加入閏秒。然而，這項長久以來的做法如今即將改變。

paragraphs.en: Philippe Richard, the director of the Swiss Federal Institute of Metrology, recently discussed this issue with NPR's Scott Simon. Richard explained metrology as the study of measurement. To help people understand timekeeping, he used an analogy of two watches: an old Swiss mechanical watch that represents the Earth and a modern quartz watch that represents precise atomic time. Because the mechanical watch runs differently, people must adjust the quartz watch to keep them aligned.
paragraphs.zh: 瑞士聯邦計量科學研究院（Swiss Federal Institute of Metrology）院長菲利普・理查（Philippe Richard）最近與 NPR 的史考特・西蒙（Scott Simon）討論了這個議題。理查將計量學解釋為度量衡的研究。為了幫助人們理解計時的概念，他用兩只手錶做比喻：一只代表地球的瑞士老舊機械錶，以及一只代表精確原子時間的現代石英錶。由於機械錶的運轉方式有所不同，人們必須調整石英錶以使兩者保持一致。

paragraphs.en: At a recent meeting of the General Conference on Weights and Measures in Versailles, near Paris, member states voted to abandon leap seconds. Instead of making frequent small adjustments, they decided to introduce a leap hour. Since 1972, a total of 27 leap seconds have been added, which equals about one every two years. To accumulate an entire leap hour, it will probably take between 4,000 and 7,000 years. Richard pointed out that this decision essentially passes the problem on to future generations.
paragraphs.zh: 在鄰近巴黎的凡爾賽所舉行的國際度量衡大會（General Conference on Weights and Measures）近期會議上，各會員國投票決定廢除閏秒。他們決定引入閏時，而非進行頻繁的小幅調整。自 1972 年以來，全球總共增加了二十七個閏秒，相當於平均每兩年增加一秒。若要累積到整整一個小時的閏時，可能需要四千年到七千年的時間。理查指出，這項決定實質上是把問題推給了未來的世代。

paragraphs.en: According to Richard, ordinary people will not notice this change at all, just as they never noticed past leap seconds. However, precise timekeeping remains extremely important behind the scenes. Accurate measurement is crucial for synchronizing power grids, operating computer networks, and supporting satellite positioning systems. Although metrology works quietly in everyday life, modern society depends on these exact measurements to function smoothly.
paragraphs.zh: 根據理查的說法，一般民眾完全不會察覺到這項改變，就像他們從未注意到過去的閏秒一樣。然而，在幕後，精確的計時仍然極為重要。準確的測量對於電網同步、電腦網路運作以及支援衛星定位系統來說至關重要。雖然計量學在日常生活中默默運作，但現代社會仰賴這些精準的測量才能順暢運轉。

grammar.explain: 逗號後面的現在分詞片語「making...」為主動分詞構句，用來表示前面子句所伴隨導致的結果。
grammar.example: In reality, the Earth's spin has slowed down slightly, making each day last 24 hours plus a few microseconds.

grammar.explain: 關係代名詞「that」引導形容詞子句，在子句中作主詞，用來修飾前面的先行詞「an old Swiss mechanical watch」。
